title: Mountain Trail
description: A hiker crosses an open alpine valley toward a lake and a cabin: room to fly a drone or phone camera, with a ridge reveal, a slope dive, a low track and a wide.

environment.description: A wide alpine valley on an early-autumn morning: green-gold meadows, a still blue-green lake, dark pine stands, a lone timber cabin, a packed-dirt trail and granite ridges with fresh snow on the summits
environment.style: Photoreal outdoor adventure film. Low morning sun, crisp clear air, light haze on the distant ridges, natural colour. No logos, brand names, badges, signage or lettering anywhere

entities.name: Alpine terrain
entities.notes: Alpine valley floor of green-gold meadow grass and late wildflowers, granite ridges and scree slopes, fresh snow on the highest summits

entities.name: Glacial lake
entities.notes: Still glacial lake, deep blue-green, mirror reflections of the peaks

entities.name: Trail 1.1
entities.notes: Narrow packed-dirt hiking trail worn into the meadow

entities.name: Cabin
entities.notes: Small weathered log cabin with a dark green metal roof, a stone chimney and a covered front porch

entities.name: Moraine 1
entities.notes: Lichen-grey granite boulders piled into a low moraine ridge

entities.name: Pine West shore 1
entities.notes: Tall dark-green subalpine firs and pines

entities.name: Hiker
entities.notes: An adult hiker in a teal waterproof shell jacket, charcoal trekking trousers, a rust-red daypack and brown leather boots; short dark hair, steady easy stride
entities.styleNotes: Plain outdoor clothing without logos or lettering

shots.title: Ridge reveal
shots.description: @hiker walks the trail across the open meadow toward the lake and the cabin, small in the wide valley; morning light rakes across the moraine boulders.

shots.title: Slope dive
shots.description: @hiker strides along the trail at an easy pace at the foot of a steep grassy slope scattered with stones.

shots.title: Trail track
shots.description: @hiker walks steadily along the packed-dirt trail, boots scuffing a little dust, the daypack swaying with each step; the lake and the pines lie beyond.

shots.title: Valley wide
shots.description: @hiker crosses the meadow on the trail toward the cabin; the lake lies still and the peaks stand clear beyond.
